# Downloadable releases

- `Hauntlight.html`: self-contained desktop app. Double-click on Mac or Windows.
- `Hauntlight-Desktop-v1.2.0.zip`: desktop HTML, quick start, and license notices.
- `hauntlight-v1.2.0.zip`: reviewed source plus the desktop HTML.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums for the current three artifacts.

Run `python3 scripts/package-source.py` to regenerate from source. Earlier version archives are retained for reproducibility. Personal layouts are never added; use Export layout separately.
